verdict.text: The registry's current submission for this Party is NDC 3.0, filed 2025-11-13. 47 observed values are loaded from DS-02 (11), DS-35 (35), DS-40 (1). For 2024 the sources disagree: DS-35 398.1 MtCO₂e, DS-02 384.1 MtCO₂e. They are on different inventory scopes and the engine does not reconcile them. No implementation gap is reported: 35 observed years are loaded, but no NDC target emissions figure has been parsed, so there is nothing to measure the trend against. It submitted BTR1. 3 of 8 components have been confirmed in the document; the rest are unparsed, which is not a finding against the country. ND-GAIN scores it 35.6 for 2024. In the first NDC round, WRI's CAIT assessment recorded: 1% (unconditional) to 14% (conditional) reduction in GHG emissions by 2035 compared to the BAU scenario It was classed both. That is a 2016 assessment of an earlier submission, not the target above. Projected warming for 2080-2099 against 1995-2014 ranges from +1.6°C under SSP1-2.6 to +5.71°C under SSP5-8.5. These are model runs, not observations.
